body: U+0023# Accessibility sweep: spec approved, build running, phone half capturedU+000AU+000AU+002A*Spec.** `docs/specs/accessibility-sweep.md` (git-ignored). The spec reviewer found 9 issues, all fixed before the owner approved. The one change to the approved read-back: the phone tool applies five rules, not six. Missing on/off state is widget-only, because Android's bridge reports a CheckBox or Switch only when the state exists.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Build.** mitosis run `~/.mitosis/runs/field-notes/2026-09-25-a11y-sweep`, one MSP `a11y-sweep`, 6 Lanes. The local `feat/composer-editor-core` was fast-forwarded to 04f07d0 first. The rules engine, phone tool and settings sweep are done; the settings baseline has 31 lines.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Phone half.** 51 `uiautomator` dumps from the plain 04f07d0 build on the Galaxy Note 10+, in `testkit/results/android/a11y-sweep/{dumps,shots}`. The tool finds 488 findings: 367 small target (the tab bar alone is about 250), 74 missing role, 44 unlabelled, 3 repeated text, and 0 doubled targets (the #204 fix held).U+000AU+000AU+002A*Not captured:**U+000AU+002D a1 and a6 (empty Today, empty Garden) need deleting all data.U+000AU+002D b3 needs Reclaim space, which deletes files.U+000AU+002D b1 with spell check available: the phone reports spell check unavailable.U+000AU+002D d7 was taken on Sept 24, because tapping today opens the Today tab.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Seeded on the phone:** a long note ("Harbour walk"), a 10 s voice memo, a 10 s video, a Sept 24 note ("Market day"), and today's mood set to Grateful.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Outside the six rules: buttons with no tap action.** A new problem class. `Semantics(button, label)` wraps a detector whose tap is excluded, via `excludeSemantics: true`, `ExcludeSemantics` or `excludeFromSemantics: true`. Confirmed on the phone:U+000AU+002D Strikethrough, Highlight and Inline code (`format_bar.dart:395`)U+000AU+002D Earlier log and Later log (`log_viewer_panel.dart:553`)U+000AU+002D the day sheet's Close (`day_detail_header.dart:82`)U+000AU+000AA code scan also flags "This week" (`calendar_header.dart:268`). It is unverified whether TalkBack's tap fallback rescues these. This is a candidate seventh rule for the fix spec.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Other observations outside the rules:**U+000AU+002D To-dos are read twice: as a checkbox, and in a glyph text line.U+000AU+002D Two Undo buttons show at once when the photo-removed toast is up.U+000AU+002D The garden plot has no description.U+000AU+002D The month picker leaves the calendar behind it reachable and has an unlabelled scrim.U+000AU+002D The weekday header reads as letters.U+000AU+002D The week-start select's node spans the whole row, but only the button responds to taps.
